title: $20,000 to Make NPCs Awesome?! Yes, Please.
author: TheRealIndie
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/26q40kv26oif1.png?width=625&format=png&auto=webp&s=b41012d1f7579e1142b739446d496b230fdde1bb

Ever wished your NPCs could actually remember you? Roast you? Give you a quest that isn’t just “fetch 10 rats”?

We’re making it happen.  
From **Aug 25 – Sept 15**, the **It’s Alive! AI NPC Jam** is your chance to create NPCs with brains, personality, and maybe even better life advice than your real friends.

🏆 **$20,000 in prizes.**  
🧠 NPCs that aren’t brain-dead.  
🔥 Player2 will feature the top 10 so the whole world can play them.

Sign up now: [https://itch.io/jam/its-alive-ai-npc](https://itch.io/jam/its-alive-ai-npc)  
Got questions? Hit the Discord: [https://discord.gg/JBccZnjKpG](https://discord.gg/JBccZnjKpG)

Bring your weirdest, smartest, funniest NPC ideas. Let’s make game history… or at least make villagers that stop staring at walls.
